'''María Gracia Manzano Arjona''' (born 1950){{r|loc}} is a Spanish philosopher specializing in [[mathematical logic]] and [[model theory]].

Manzano earned her Ph.D. in 1977 from the [[University of Barcelona]]. Her dissertation, ''Sistemas generales de la lógica de segundo orden'' [General systems of [[second-order logic]]], was supervised by [[Jesús Mosterín]].{{r|mgp}} She is a professor of logic and the [[philosophy of science]] at the [[University of Salamanca]].{{r|usal}}

She is the author of several books on logic and model theory:

* {{citation |last=Manzano |first=María |title=Teoría de modelos|language=es|year=1989 |publisher=[[Alianza Editorial]]|url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/277269984|
isbn=9788420681269}}
:{{citation |last=Manzano |first=María |author-mask=0|title=Model Theory |translator-last=De Queiroz|translator-first=Ruy|year=1999 |orig-year=1989|publisher=[[Oxford University Press]] |series=Oxford Logic Guides |volume=37|isbn=978-0198538516}}{{r|mt}}
* {{citation |last=Manzano|first=María |title=[[Extensions of First Order Logic]]|language=en|year=1996|series=Cambridge Tracts in Theoretical Computer Science|volume=19|publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]|isbn=0521354358}}{{r|x1l}}
* {{citation |last1=Manzano |first1=María |last2=Huertas |first2=Antonia|title=Lógica para principiantes|language=es|year=2004 |publisher=[[Alianza Editorial]]}}
